notes.note: Reviewed for fix round 4 (inputs: docs/architecture/module-map.md). Fix round 4 is confined to desktop startup recovery: the renderer bundled-profile bootstrap treats starting/restarting/stopping as progressing and, for a failed/stopped owned sidecar, waits in place while the main window is covered and releases at once (no polling) in a shown window, via a new read-only startup_window_admitted command (tauri.ts/web.ts/types.ts adapter method); the background reload and its poll loop were removed; the deadline and re-offer timer threads are pinned to their exact shape; the fronting decision gets a consult-only source pin instead of a tautological unit test; OnboardingGate's comment was updated. Searched this document for startup-readiness, cover, bootstrap, loader, reload, window-admission and native-command claims affected by these inputs and found none; its cited claims remain accurate. No prose change.
